summary: Cloud scan of https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com complete. Found 18 critical and 3 high vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Server Technology Disclosure
findings.evidence: Server: Heroku
findings.description: The 'Server' HTTP header is present in the response, disclosing the underlying web server technology as Heroku. This information can be used by attackers to identify known vulnerabilities or misconfigurations associated with this specific server platform.
findings.recommendation: While Heroku is a platform-as-a-service, reducing information leakage is generally a good security practice. If possible, consider configuring the application or proxy to remove or obfuscate the 'Server' header.

findings.title: Proxy Technology Disclosure (Via Header)
findings.evidence: Via: 1.1 heroku-router
findings.description: The 'Via' HTTP header reveals the presence and type of a proxy server ('heroku-router') handling the request. This exposes details about the network architecture, which could potentially assist an attacker in mapping the infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Similar to the 'Server' header, it is recommended to remove or obfuscate the 'Via' header if not strictly necessary for operational purposes, to reduce information disclosure about the network topology.

findings.title: Exposed robots.txt File
findings.evidence:
HTTP 200 — Body: User-agent: *
Disallow: /ftp
findings.description: The `robots.txt` file is publicly accessible and contains directives for web crawlers. Specifically, it includes `Disallow: /ftp`, indicating the presence of an `/ftp` directory. While `robots.txt` is not a security mechanism, it can inadvertently disclose information about the application's structure and sensitive paths to potential attackers.
findings.recommendation: Ensure that any paths listed in `robots.txt` do not contain sensitive functionality or data that should be protected. Rely on proper authentication and authorization controls for security, rather than obscurity through `robots.txt`. Investigate the `/ftp` path for actual content and potential vulnerabilities.

findings.title: HSTS (Strict-Transport-Security) Header Missing
findings.evidence: HTTP Response did not contain 'Strict-Transport-Security' header. Status: 200
findings.description: The HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) header is not present in the HTTP response. This allows browsers to connect to the site over insecure HTTP before being redirected to HTTPS, making the initial connection vulnerable to SSL stripping attacks and cookie hijacking by a man-in-the-middle.
findings.recommendation: Implement the `Strict-Transport-Security` header with an appropriate `max-age` directive to enforce HTTPS-only communication. For example: `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload`.

findings.title: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Missing
findings.evidence: HTTP Response did not contain 'Content-Security-Policy' header. Status: 200
findings.description: The Content Security Policy (CSP) header is missing from the HTTP response. Without a CSP, the application is more susceptible to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), data injection, and other client-side attacks, as the browser is not restricted in loading resources from trusted sources.
findings.recommendation: Implement a robust Content Security Policy to whitelist trusted sources for various content types (scripts, styles, images, etc.). Start with a strict policy and gradually relax it as necessary, e.g., `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' ...;`.

findings.title: X-XSS-Protection Header Missing
findings.evidence: HTTP Response did not contain 'X-XSS-Protection' header. Status: 200
findings.description: The `X-XSS-Protection` header is not present in the HTTP response. While modern browsers have built-in XSS filters, this header provides an additional layer of defense against certain types of Cross-Site Scripting attacks, especially in older browsers.
findings.recommendation: Add the `X-XSS-Protection` header with a value of `1; mode=block` to enable the browser's XSS filter and prevent rendering of pages when a reflected XSS attack is detected. Example: `X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block`.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy Header Missing
findings.evidence: HTTP Response did not contain 'Referrer-Policy' header. Status: 200
findings.description: The `Referrer-Policy` header is missing from the HTTP response. This may lead to sensitive information being leaked in the Referer header when navigating to external sites, potentially exposing user activity or internal paths.
findings.recommendation: Implement a `Referrer-Policy` header to control how much referrer information is sent with requests. Recommended policies include `no-referrer`, `same-origin`, or `strict-origin-when-cross-origin` based on application requirements.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy Header Missing
findings.evidence: HTTP Response did not contain 'Permissions-Policy' header. Status: 200
findings.description: The `Permissions-Policy` header (formerly Feature-Policy) is missing. This header allows a website to explicitly control which browser features and APIs are available to the document and its embedded iframes, mitigating risks associated with powerful features.
findings.recommendation: Implement a `Permissions-Policy` header to restrict the use of unnecessary or powerful browser features. Define a policy that only allows the features essential for the application's functionality.

findings.title: HSTS Missing — Forces HTTPS
findings.evidence: HTTP Response did not contain 'Strict-Transport-Security' header. Status: 200
findings.description: The response from https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com is missing the 'Strict-Transport-Security' security header.
findings.recommendation: Add the 'Strict-Transport-Security' header to all server responses.

findings.title: No CSP — XSS easier to exploit
findings.evidence: HTTP Response did not contain 'Content-Security-Policy' header. Status: 200
findings.description: The response from https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com is missing the 'Content-Security-Policy' security header.
findings.recommendation: Add the 'Content-Security-Policy' header to all server responses.

findings.title: XSS Browser Protection Disabled
findings.evidence: HTTP Response did not contain 'X-XSS-Protection' header. Status: 200
findings.description: The response from https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com is missing the 'X-XSS-Protection' security header.
findings.recommendation: Add the 'X-XSS-Protection' header to all server responses.

findings.title: Referrer Leakage Possible
findings.evidence: HTTP Response did not contain 'Referrer-Policy' header. Status: 200
findings.description: The response from https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com is missing the 'Referrer-Policy' security header.
findings.recommendation: Add the 'Referrer-Policy' header to all server responses.

findings.description: The response from https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com is missing the 'Permissions-Policy' security header.
findings.recommendation: Add the 'Permissions-Policy' header to all server responses.
